designs.name: 01-golden-art-nouveau
designs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE landscape 16:9 high fidelity 3D GAME ENVIRONMENT CONCEPT IMAGE for Neverland, an ornate spectacular fantasy AMUSEMENT PARK that a player explores on foot. Show a cohesive modeled 3D environment, not flat illustration, not low-poly blocks, not a photomontage. Eye-level first-person camera at 1.65m, 24mm wide angle from a wooden arrival deck looking along an inviting curved main promenade. Clearly visible ride silhouettes: large Ferris wheel on left middle distance, ornate carousel to right, Captain Hook swinging pirate ship near foreground side, mirror maze pavilion and spinning teacup ride further along. Park should feel lush, expensive, full of festive light and richly dressed, not an empty square: attractive ticket booths, railing details, benches, planted borders, patterned paving, ornamental lamps, hanging bunting and strings of bulbs, inviting paths joining five districts. Clear walkable circulation, foreground/midground/background depth, detailed geometry and tactile stylized PBR materials, convincing perspective and shadows. No people, no characters, no HUD, no text, no logos, no comparison panels. Mysterious romantic fairytale charm; luminous atmospheric twilight with a readable colored sky, not dark horror or abandoned ruins. THIS IS A DESIGN PROPOSAL not a screenshot of an existing implementation. Direction 1: GILDED ART NOUVEAU ROYAL PARK. Deep emerald painted iron, antique gold filigree, ivory sculpted facades, dusty-rose velvet striped carousel canopy, graceful curving ironwork, abundant warm golden bulbs, fine decorative arches over the promenade. Ferris wheel looks like a giant ornate celestial clock; carousel intricate hand-carved horses. Pale mint and peach late-afternoon sky. Airy thin mist confined to distance. The visual signature is lush golden elegance and exceptionally intricate emerald/gold architecture. Grand unified park composition, high-end polished real-time 3D art direction.
